description: Files every repository of the family must carry BYTE-IDENTICALLY, pinned with their SHA-256. SPEC-004 §3 (the family manifest) and CVR-001 §5.2 priority 2; verified by scripts/tasks/manifest.ts (`pnpm run manifest` rewrites this file from the working tree, `pnpm run manifest:check` runs inside `validate`). A listed file is a FAMILY file: change it in all five repositories (01-hilbert-polya, 02-odd-zeta, 03-crystalline-worldsheet, 04-mersenne-cr, 05-kk-golden-throat), then run `pnpm run manifest` in each one and commit the refreshed manifest together with the change. SHA-256 is the digest of the checksum-manifest ecosystem; `sha256sum <file>` prints the same value.

excluded.package.json: per-repository identity root (name, version, description, scripts, metadata) — asserted by scripts/tasks/parity.ts instead
excluded.CITATION.cff: identity root of each repository (authors, title, license, repository-code): hand-edited, never shared
excluded..zenodo.json: generated per repository from CITATION.cff by scripts/tasks/citation.ts
excluded.pyproject.toml: per-repository Python project and dependency set
excluded.uv.lock: lockfile of that per-repository dependency set
excluded..gitignore: repository-specific ignores (04 differs from the family)
excluded..chktexrc: not family-wide: 01/04/05 carry one, 02/03 none, and the copies differ
excluded.scripts/tasks/counts.ts: per-repository counter table by design: its counters, Lean file list and marked regions are that repository's own (SPEC-004 §3.1)
excluded.scripts/shared-files.json: this manifest — a file cannot contain its own digest
excluded.docs/witness-inventory.md: per-repository census generated from that repository own measurement — its counts differ by design (SPEC-004 §3)
